title: Chapter 7 Quiz
description: Test your mastery of control flow: if/else, switch, loops, and enums!

questions.question: What does an if statement do?
options: Executes code only when a condition is true
questions.explanation: if checks a condition; the block runs only when the condition evaluates to true.

questions.question: What will the following code output? int x = 10; if (x < 5) Debug.Log("A"); else Debug.Log("B");
questions.explanation: 10 < 5 is false, so the else block runs, printing B.

questions.question: The condition inside an if statement can be any expression that returns true or false.
questions.explanation: Conditions must be boolean expressions.

questions.question: What is the correct way to check if two values are equal?
questions.explanation: == is the equality operator. = is assignment.

questions.question: Which logical operator represents AND?
questions.explanation: && is logical AND; || is OR, ! is NOT.

questions.question: What will be printed? int num = 3; if (num > 0 && num < 5) Debug.Log("Yes"); else Debug.Log("No");
questions.explanation: Both conditions are true, so the if block runs.

questions.question: How many else if blocks can you have?
questions.explanation: You can chain as many else if as needed.

questions.question: In a switch statement, what keyword ends each case?
questions.explanation: Each case must end with break (or return, throw, etc.).

questions.question: What is the purpose of the default case in a switch?
options: To run when no other case matches
questions.explanation: default is executed if none of the case values match.

questions.question: How many times does this loop run? int i = 0; while (i < 3) { i++; }
questions.explanation: i starts at 0, loops until i=3 (when condition i<3 fails). So 0,1,2 → 3 iterations.

questions.question: What does the 'break' statement do inside a loop?
questions.explanation: break immediately terminates the loop.

questions.question: What is the difference between while and do-while?
options: do-while checks the condition after the body runs, so it always executes at least once
questions.explanation: do-while guarantees one execution; while may skip entirely.

questions.question: Which part of a for loop sets the initial value?
questions.explanation: The first part (e.g., int i=0) is the initialization.

questions.question: How many times does this for loop run? for (int i = 0; i < 10; i += 2)
questions.explanation: i values: 0,2,4,6,8 → 5 iterations.

questions.question: What is the output of this nested loop? for (int i=0; i<2; i++) { for (int j=0; j<3; j++) Debug.Log(i+j); }
Which loop is ideal for iterating over all elements of an array without needing an index?
questions.explanation: foreach directly accesses each element.

questions.question: Can you modify the collection while inside a foreach loop?
options: No, it will throw an exception
questions.explanation: Modifying a collection during foreach causes an InvalidOperationException.

questions.question: What is an enum?
options: A set of named integer constants
questions.explanation: enum stands for enumeration, a group of related named values.

questions.question: How does a public enum variable appear in the Inspector?
questions.explanation: Enums are displayed as convenient dropdown menus.

questions.question: A switch statement can be used with string types.
questions.explanation: C# supports switching on strings (and int, char, enums, etc.).

questions.question: What keyword is used to skip the rest of the current loop iteration and move to the next?
questions.explanation: continue moves to the next loop iteration.

questions.question: Which of the following is a valid for loop?
questions.explanation: Correct syntax: for (initialization; condition; increment)

questions.question: What will this do? while (true) { Debug.Log("Running..."); }
questions.explanation: Infinite loop with no break; Unity will hang.

questions.question: What is the advantage of using enums over plain integers for states?
options: Enums self-document the code and prevent invalid values
questions.explanation: Enums give meaningful names and type safety.
